handoff.notes:
# Plan (muse-spark-1.3-contributor, medium)

## Goal

The AI counts Cleave's neighbour hits in its two combat models, with no engine or spec change (R63 and R346 are settled and only cited). In `damage_past_taunts` a bound Cleave attacker splashes its attack onto the defender's live neighbouring Taunts, so a killed neighbour stops binding the remaining attackers; in `trade_value` neighbour kills add their `unit_worth` and popped neighbour shields add the Divine Shield weight, scaled by one new `AI_REPLY` weight. Positions without Cleave evaluate exactly as before.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | `AiReply` gains `cleave_share: f64`; `AI_REPLY` sets it to `1.0` |
| `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs` | change | `Side`, `side_of`, `Blow`, `blow` move here from `reply.rs` as `pub(crate)`; `Exchange` gains `pub splash: i32`; new `pub(crate) fn cleaved_neighbours` |
| `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` | change | `trade_value` prices Cleave neighbour kills and shield pops; imports the moved items |
| `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` | change | `damage_past_taunts` models Cleave splash onto neighbouring Taunts |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/cleave.rs` | new | Six tests in the style of `pierce.rs` |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/mod.rs` | change | Add `pub mod cleave;` between `answer_key` and `combat_mods` |

Must not touch: everything in `crates/engine/`, `crates/cards/`, `spec/` (no new ruling; R63 and R346 are cited, not added), `GREEDY_EVAL` in `config.rs` (the frozen baseline; `EvalWeights` is unchanged), `kills_and_survives`/`attack_tier` in `candidates.rs` (move-order tiering stays single-target), `apps/web/`, `e2e/`, and every forbidden path. Governing spec: §4.3–§4.4 (Cleave step 10, R63), §6.1 (Cleave), §9.9 (practice AI, opponent's reply, evaluation).

## Steps

1. Confirm there is exactly one `AiReply` struct literal. Search for `AiReply {` across the repo. Only `config.rs` is expected to construct it. If another literal exists, set its new field to the same value.
2. In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, add to `AiReply` after `chip_per_damage`: the share of a cleaved neighbour's payoff the reply counts, documented as pricing only board-dependent kills while the static `cleave` body weight in `AI_EVAL.keyword` keeps pricing the body. Set `cleave_share: 1.0` in `AI_REPLY`. Do not touch `EvalWeights`, `AI_EVAL`, or `GREEDY_EVAL`.
3. In `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`, move `Side`, `side_of`, `Blow`, and `blow` verbatim from `reply.rs` and mark each `pub(crate)` (add `slot_of` and `adjacent` to the existing `jackioh_engine` import; `card_at`, `has_keyword`, `pierces`, `unit_view`, `KeywordKind`, `UnitView`, `CardInstance` are already imported). One §4.4 implementation serves both callers. Extend `Exchange` with `pub splash: i32`, set in `exchange()` to `a.attack + bonus.attack`: the bonus rides but the lane multiplier does not, exactly as the engine's `strike` passes unmultiplied `attack` as the Cleave amount (`crates/engine/src/combat.rs`) and `struck_by` gives neighbours `attack` (`crates/engine/src/subsystems/lethal.rs`). Add `pub(crate) fn cleaved_neighbours(state, attacker, target) -> Vec<CardInstance>`: empty unless the attacker has Cleave in `unit_view(state, attacker).keywords`; otherwise `slot_of(state, target)`, each `adjacent` slot, each `card_at` cloned. This mirrors `struck_by` minus the defender.
4. In `crates/ai/src/reply.rs`, delete the moved items and import them from `crate::candidates`. In `trade_value`, after the First Strike adjustment and before `let mut value`, add the Cleave block: if the attacker has Cleave and not (`t.first_strike && !a.first_strike && dies`, the case where the engine's defender-first branch strikes nothing at all), then for each `cleaved_neighbours(state, attacker, target)` compute `blow(&a, combat.splash, combat.poisonous, &n)`; on `kills` add `AI_REPLY.cleave_share * unit_worth(state, &neighbour, &AI_EVAL)`; on `pops_shield` (and not kills) add `AI_REPLY.cleave_share * AI_EVAL.keyword.divine_shield`. No chip for partial splash damage, no Trample-to-face credit: the main target gets neither, so neighbours get neither. Update `trade_value`'s doc comment with one sentence citing R63.
5. In `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, rework `damage_past_taunts` to carry mutable per-Taunt state. Replace the `taunts: Vec<(&CardInstance, UnitView)>` collection with `Vec<TauntStand>` (new private struct: `unit: CardInstance` cloned, `view: UnitView`, `shield: bool`, `health: i32`), sorted by `view.health + view.armor` as today, and iterate by index. The current `shield`/`health` locals become `stands[i]` fields; the Reborn tail (`reborn_body`) replaces `stands[i]` with the reborn stand (shield recomputed from the new view's keywords, health from the new view) or removes nothing, preserving today's re-loop over the same index. After the `falls_to_first_strike` check (which `continue`s with no splash, per the engine: a destroyed-first attacker strikes nothing), when the attacker has Cleave, splash each live neighbour: resolve `cleaved_neighbours(state, attacker, &taunt_unit)` to stand indices by instance id, skipping the target itself, already-processed indices (their binding is resolved), and non-Taunt neighbours (they free nothing). For each, run `blow(&side_of(state, attacker), attack, poisonous, &side_of(state, &nb))` where `poisonous` is the attacker's Poisonous keyword only (combat-only bonuses stay out of the threat model, still #1094's scope) and `attack` is the bound tuple's figure already carried. On `pops_shield` set `stands[j].shield = false`. Otherwise, if the attacker has Trample and `dealt > stands[j].health`, add `subsystems::projected_hero_damage(state, defender, dealt - health, pierce)` to the total, mirroring the main hit. On `kills`, a Reborn neighbour becomes its `reborn_body` stand (or is removed when the body has no Taunt); otherwise remove index `j` (only `j > i` is ever removed, so `i` stays valid). Else persist `stands[j].health -= dealt`. Import `adjacent`, `card_at`, `slot_of` from `jackioh_engine` and `blow`, `cleaved_neighbours`, `side_of` from `crate::candidates`. Update the function's doc comment: Cleave stays out is replaced by this paragraph citing R63; Lane strike and combat-only bonuses still stay out.
6. Add `crates/ai/tests/ai/cleave.rs` (see Tests) and register the module. Copy the `grant` helper pattern from `pierce.rs` only if needed; the boards below use printed keywords except where noted.
7. Run the new tests, then the full `jackioh-ai` suite, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo jackioh spec check`. Do not run the workspace suite, the gates, or fuzz.

## Tests

New file `crates/ai/tests/ai/cleave.rs`, using `register_cards`/`scenario` boards (field entries fill consecutive lanes, so two listed units are adjacent) and real cards: Nurse Cleaver (`classic-073`, 3/6, base-face Cleave), Zoomerbin Oomen (`core-067`, 1/2), Jilliax (`core-056`, 3/2 Divine Shield), Jay Fungus (`classicplus-049`, 3/6 Taunt), Tommy Tempo (`classicplus-026`, 5/5 Taunt), Midrange Menace (`core-019`, 9/9), Tempo Timmy (`core-011`, 3/3, non-Cleave control attacker).
